description: Phase A production-hardening (ROADMAP.md Phase A; prd-pinakes-deep-history-roadmap.md §16 / §"Not yet hardened"). The atlas engine and the 14/15-domain corpus are shipped, but the UI stories are only unit-test-gated — never browser-verified against the POPULATED Neo4j graph. Bring the full stack up against real data (`bun run dev:full` + `bun run smoke:graph`) and drive the existing Playwright specs (e2e/{graph-ui,civilizations,smoke}.spec.ts) against it, so a green suite means the atlas actually renders the populated corpus, not fixtures. Coverage reality: only 3 specs exist while the atlas ships 8+ major UI surfaces — so this tasklist also AUTHORS specs for the currently uncovered surfaces (US-3), not just re-runs the existing three. Scope: e2e/ specs (existing + new), the smoke:graph/dev:full wiring, web/ fixes surfaced by real data, and docs. The corpus (§15) is shipped, so this depends on nothing.

userStories.title: Stand the full stack up against the populated graph and smoke it
userStories.description: Bring the FastAPI service + Vite client up against a corpus-loaded Neo4j and confirm the graph surface answers with real data via the existing smoke:graph gate.
acceptanceCriteria: `bun run dev:full` starts the Python service and the client together against a Neo4j loaded from build/corpus (or a documented reduced fixture load), with a repeatable, documented one-command bring-up.
`bun run smoke:graph` passes against that populated graph and asserts non-empty results for the core domains (civilizations, sites, deities, writing systems, languages), not empty/fixture responses.
A short docs/ runbook records the bring-up + the corpus load step so the verification is reproducible; `.chief/verify.sh` passes on the diff.

userStories.title: Drive the Playwright specs against real data and fix what breaks
userStories.description: Run the existing e2e specs against the populated stack, fixing the web/ or route defects that only surface with real data, so the unit-gated UI stories are browser-verified.
acceptanceCriteria: `bun run test:e2e` runs e2e/{graph-ui,civilizations,smoke}.spec.ts against the populated stack and passes; specs assert on real corpus content (a real civilization/lineage renders end to end), not just that the page loads.

Any web/ or /api defect the real-data run exposes is fixed; `bun run check` (tsc over web/ + contracts) and `bun run test` (vitest) stay green, and `bun run check:scripts` passes if scripts/ is touched.
The e2e run is wired so it is runnable in CI / by hand with the documented bring-up.

userStories.title: Author Playwright specs for the uncovered atlas surfaces
userStories.description: The 3 existing specs cover a fraction of the shipped UI; author new e2e/ specs for the major surfaces that today have zero browser coverage, driven against the populated stack.
acceptanceCriteria: New Playwright specs (e2e/*.spec.ts — never *.test.ts, per e2e/CLAUDE.md) cover the currently uncovered surfaces: the immersive 3D globe (web/src/pages/immersive.tsx flat-map/globe/gallery toggle, WebGL feature-detection handled), the cultural lineage explorer (CulturalLineageExplorer / the ancestry page), the Sankey/chord/treemap flow visualizations (SankeyDiagramVisualization / ChordDiagramVisualization and kin), the etymology analyzer (word-etymology page / EtymologyTreeVisualization), the narrative journeys/stories surface (stories.tsx), and the quizzes (quiz.tsx + shared-quiz-result.tsx).

Each new spec asserts real populated-corpus content renders (a named lineage, a real etymology chain, a non-empty flow diagram), not merely that the route mounts; a surface that legitimately cannot be e2e-driven (e.g. WebXR-only paths) is explicitly documented as excluded with the reason rather than silently skipped.
`bun run test:e2e` runs the full expanded suite green against the populated stack, and the new specs are wired into the same documented CI/by-hand bring-up as US-2.

userStories.title: Record the browser-verification coverage
userStories.description: Capture which atlas UI stories are now browser-confirmed against the populated graph and which remain gaps, so §"Not yet hardened" is honestly closed or scoped.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/ (or the roadmap's hardening note) lists each browser-verified UI story with the spec that proves it, and flags any story still un-verified with the reason.
The /api/data-quality coverage the run relies on is referenced so the verification tracks the same coverage numbers the atlas reports.
